duplicate_source_company_ids.note: Pairs of SOURCE 'companies' that are the same business twice, the duplicate created by a second lead-magnet submission. SOURCE is read-only to this tooling (the API key has no write scope), so the duplicate cannot be merged at the source -- instead the superseded id is aliased to the surviving one wherever a SOURCE company id is resolved to its organizations record (Deal seller, Buyer Role/Seller Role parent). Maps superseded SOURCE company id -> surviving SOURCE company id. Verified 2026-09-07: every one of the ten ids now has its own migrated organizations record, so the original framing (the duplicate 'was never migrated, and so blocks resolution') is stale -- what this map now decides is which of two migrated organizations the children attach to. The invariant to check it against is is_active: all five values resolve to the organization whose is_active is true, and all five keys to one whose is_active is false. Do not judge a pair by which record looks richer -- for Aikho the active organization is the name-only one.

buyer_role.mandate_details.reason: Redundant with the existing buyer_role.investment_strategy field -- same information, two places to maintain it.

buyer_role.typical_check_size.reason: Redundant with the existing buyer_role.check_size_min/check_size_max fields -- typical_check_size was a coarse 4-option USD range bucket, check_size_min/max are real USD figures. buyer_role.typical_check_size.no_longer_synced_from: DEV buyer_role.typical_check_size (SOURCE buyer_brain.typical_check_size_7 is still read, only to backfill check_size_min/max)

buyer_role.target_geography.reason: Held three different kinds of value in one multi-select -- countries (UAE, KSA, Kuwait, Bahrain, Qatar, Oman, Egypt), a region (GCC-wide) and a no-restriction marker (Global). Nothing downstream could tell them apart, so discovery had to guess per value and once geocoded 'GCC' to Glendale Community College, California, silently narrowing a Gulf search. Replaced 2026-09-26 by target_region and target_country, which also drop the duplicate spellings: KSA and Saudi Arabia were two names for one country.

buyer_role.geographic_focus.reason: Added 2026-09-21 as a verbatim text carry-over of Organization.geographic_focus, because that vocabulary mixed countries, regions and a continent and no approved enum could hold it. Superseded 2026-09-26 by target_region/target_country, which split the same information into two approved vocabularies. Never held a value: the only writer was the buyer-vertical split, which had not been applied when this was dropped.
buyer_role.geographic_focus.no_longer_synced_from: Organization.geographic_focus (the organization attribute itself is unchanged and still in use)

note.buyer_role_id.reason: Notes live at organization level. Before the vertical re-grain a buyer had one buyer_role entry, so linking a note to the entry and linking it to the company said the same thing. After the 2026-09-26 split an organization has one entry per vertical, and the link pointed at whichever entry was patched in place -- the organization's first sector, which nobody ever asserted the conversation was about. A note carries no signal saying which vertical it concerned, so unlike match_results (re-filable by the seller's sector) the link was dropped rather than guessed.
note.buyer_role_id.scope: All 178 production notes that carried one, including the 43 whose organization still has exactly one live vertical and whose link was therefore still correct. One rule, one class of note.
note.buyer_role_id.note: Both the Attio attribute and the nullable notes.buyer_role_id column stay in place -- nothing in server/ queries either, it is write-only provenance, and new notes on a single-vertical org will still arrive with one until RoleLookup.get_active_buyer_role is changed. primary_role was deliberately NOT set on the way, per the 2026-09-27 decision to clear the buyer id and nothing else; it is empty on all 178, so the pre-clear state lives only in outputs/attio_migration/note-detach-backup-*.json.

organization.contact_person.reason: Created 2026-08-19 as a record-reference to Person, meant to resolve an org's contact via legacy_attio_id, but never actually implemented in objects.ps1/schema.ps1/sync-postgres.ps1 -- and structurally can't be, in the current pipeline: organizations sync runs before person (see sync-all.ps1's fixed dependency order), so no DEV Person records exist yet to resolve against at the point an Organization is created. Confirmed empty on every checked live record (0 of 500 sampled) before archiving -- never manually populated either.
organization.contact_person.no_longer_synced_from: never synced -- no implementation ever existed

organization.zz_kanban_test.reason: Throwaway test attribute, per its own DEV Attio description ("Throwaway test attribute - safe to delete"). Never referenced by any sync script.

notes_backfill_is_create_only.reason: backfill-notes.ps1 writes buyer_role_id on every update, so a plain re-run reattaches all 178 notes to an arbitrary vertical and silently reverts the 2026-09-27 detach. -CreateOnly skips existing records entirely.

deal_stage_aliases._note: SOURCE deals.stage titles are written verbatim into the V2 pipeline, so a SOURCE stage whose V2 counterpart is spelled differently would force a duplicate stage to exist alongside it. Added 2026-09-14 after 'Due Diligence' was created next to the V2 object's own 'LOI signed/Due Diligence'. Keys are SOURCE stage titles, values the V2 title to use instead; anything unlisted passes through unchanged. Read by both _internal/schema.ps1 (seeding) and _internal/objects.ps1 (record writes) - they must agree.
